content: Binii aditay woga
Yerusalaamepp ye7eez farasaawitayira pettii pettii higge asitamaaritay Yesuusa kale shiiqeeza.
Yesuusa tamaaritaypp pettay pettay geezhekka kusher, yeykka kushe meecinttekkazar katha miizita be7eeza.
Farasaawitaynnee Ayihuditay asii ubbay fa aditay wogay garkk fa kushe lo7ithii meecinttekkazar mooya.
Yey garkk, unttii gabepp maaqqii meeccekkazar mooya. Ma unttii fa aditaypp ekkeez hara gaame woga yeza: yeykka wancca, ota, biraata miishera arssa meecciz woga naagiza.
Farasaawitayirannee higge asitamaaritay Yesuusa, «Ne tamaaritay abiso aditay woga menthii fa kushe meecinttekkazar katha miizay?» yeegii oyceeza.
Yesuusa unttiko, «Nabe Isayaasa yinttis cubbitayis,

content.text: « ‹Yha asay tana fa iranthi aaddari bonchchiza,
zin u wozinay taapp haakko yeza.
Asii kochcheez woga Xooss higge aazisii taamarssiza gisho

content: yeegii xaafeezay turo.
«Yinttii Xooss kiita ashshii as woga naagiza» yeegeeza.
Maakka Yesuusa, «Yinttii yi woga naagodayis gi Xooss kiita olii ashsheeza
Muse, ‹Ne adenne ne indo bonchchoba›, ma ‹Fa adannee woy fa indo cazhizay yhayqqodayis beeziza› yeegeeza.
Zin yi yeegiza pettii athay fa ada woy fa indato maaddoda ashshii, ‹Yhay Xoossa yarshsho› giiko,
E fa ada woy fa indato maaddaam garkk yi udiza.
Yey garkk, yi yhankkita taamarisseez yi wogayid Xoossa qaala leqqeeza. Yey garkk hara gaame baz oothiza» yeegeeza.
As tunisiza baz
Yesuusa gaame asa maakka faako xeegii, «Ubbay ta odiza si7oyttannee akaakoytta.
As wozinapp keziz baz as tunisizapp attin balepp as ulo gelii as tunisiza baz abkka baaya.
Si7iz hayer yez oonkka si7o» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa gaame asa olii ashshii keetha gelin e tamaaritay ye aazisay bagga eza oyceeza.
E unttiko, «Yinttiskka ma gelekkasa? Balepp as gancce geliza baz abkka as tunisodayis danda7oozana akaakoosanee?
Abis giiko, katha as doonar ulo gancce gelii ezayir bale kezizaypp attin as wozina gancce gelooya» yeegeeza. Ezayid Yesuusa katha ubbay geeshshii maaqqeezana eriseeza.
Gujjikka, Yesuusa, «as tunisiza baz as wozina ganccepp keziz bazii.
As wozina ganccepp keziz baz wobbo qofa, lagita, kastto, as wodho,
laame, iita amotithii, iitatithii, gene, qayxe, doosha, qinaate, cashshe, utirannee boozatithii.
Yha iita baz ubbaykka as wozina ganccepp kezii as tunisiza» yeegeeza.
Pettii asttii ammano
Yesuusa yeypp kezii, Xiroosa katama kale yez gade yhanigeeza. E pettii kara gelii ezayid yezana oonkka erod garkk koyekkaya. Zin qosinttii gam7odayis danda7ekkaya.
Zin i xiqqa na7ato tuna ayyana aykkeez pettii astta Yesuusa oosa si7ii ellisii eziko yi7ii e tokayil afa wodhdheeza.
Iza Girike asii; yelintteezay Siroofinqqe giz biitta. Iza, fa na7atipp tuna ayyana kessod garkk Yesuusa woosseeza.
Zin Yesuusa mahii, «Na7itay tiinatii katha mizho; na7itay katha ekkii kanitayis olo koshshooya» yeegeeza.
Asita maaqqii, «Ta Godayyo yeyi tuma, zin leemate kale yez kanitay na7itaypp wodhdhiz gufa miinebay» yeegii maheeza.
Yesuusa ma iziko, «Yha ne qaalay gishos ne kara qitoba; tuna ayyana ne na7atipp kezeeza» yeegeeza.
Izakka fa kara yhanigodar tuna ayyana i na7atipp kezin arssal woyi7eezanno denggeeza.
Yesuusa tullennee muume atha patheeza
Yesuusa ma Xiroosa katamapp kezii, Sidoonaranne Taphphii Katamita giz biittar aadhii Galila Abbako yhanigeeza.
Asay tullennee deddatiza as Yesuusako ki7ii, fa kushe ezal afa gaddod garkk eza woosseeza.
Yesuusa aadda ye atha gaame asaypp gaxa kessii, fa biradhdhe e hayayid dakkeeza. Ma yeypp cuchchii cuttii e irantha bochcheeza.
Salo fude dhoqqi gi bi7ii, woossii, «Eftah» geeza. Bili7ithaykka «Dooyinttoba» guusii.
Athay hayay ellisii dooyintteeza, accintteez iranthaykka bili7intteeza, athay bili7inttii odintteeza.
Yesuusa asayiko, «Yhaya ooskka odippate» yeegeeza. Zin E lo7ithii miinthii odippate gin, asay oda gede dalgiseeza.
Yeya si7eez as ubbay lo7ithii malabaz gi, «Ubba baz e lo7ithii oothiza. Hara attozin, tulle sissiza, muume odisiza» yeegeeza.
